title: Achoris

description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-11 (Table 1, "Proposed Dynasty 20 Rulers and Reigns"); its dates are display only.
